test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

L + B means L is the father of B,

L - B means L is the mother of B,

L × B means L is the son of B,

L ÷ B means L is the daughter of B.

Based on the above, if Z ÷ Y + S × V - U, then how is Z related to V?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png]

Statement given : Z ÷ Y + S × V - U

So,

 
• Z ÷ Y → Z is the daughter of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c817a76349d097a5a3f45f4781f82a97b520544a9eebdb2ef5110263af441ca1.png] 

 
• Y + S → Y is the father of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dab514c73468da1bb920af155e8980e932ce08940fd65e7fe4eb39453cdc80b.png] 

 
• S × V → S is the son of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ad70aed589bfa4ea676054706bbdf9cea740e82577d6d0c3f907e52ce8d7fd9.png] 

 
• V - U → V is the mother of U.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad21b4ed853dfd3b8dc837786bce6e2fde93177057254cd6859a040634919ea7.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree Z is the daughter of V.​

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.
